name: phone-input
title: Phone input
description: A phone field with a country picker (flag, calling code, a searchable list you can drive with the keyboard) and the number formatted as you type, (415) 555-0132. A check pops in once the digit count fits the country; paste or autofill a +44 number and the country follows, with the flag flipping over.
author: UI Stacks <https://uistacks.dev>
